firmware_banner: RANGE: trained +/-90 deg; approximate extrapolated PWM 700..2300 us.
UPRIGHT: stable level base eases both targets to zero, then holds; tilt/spin returns to recovery.
GUARDS: USB trials need heartbeat and have 60 s limit; standalone keeps sensor/timing/battery stops.
INACTIVITY: 60 s without base IMU motion stops PWM until reboot; charge stays available.
BOOT: battery only auto-starts after initialization; USB at startup keeps PWM off.
POWER: stop/charge remove PWM only. Rev C master switch OFF + USB unplugged is full OFF.
Commands: arm, run, standalone, charge (PWM off), shadow (no PWM), keep, off, !, state, sensors (non-stopping), status, help
handoff_acknowledgement: STANDALONE: running; USB may be unplugged. Rev C: switch OFF after unplugging USB for full OFF.
